name: zanker-icon-curation
description: Select semantically correct icons with coherent family/weight and license metadata.

workflow.instruction: Inventory project icon library and existing semantic mappings.
Run `bash ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/icons.sh --query analytics` to get cross-family candidates.
Choose single dominant visual grammar; evaluate meaning, recognition and accessible names.
Add source/license metadata; replace icons only when they improve meaning or consistency.

acceptance: No icon-only button without accessible name
fallback: Describe candidate glyph in words and preserve project library.
